title: USCG Station Cortez Carpet Removal and Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) Flooring Installation
description:
COMBINED SYNOPSIS / SOLICITATION FOR COMMERCIAL SERVICES 

  Solicitation Number:  30326PR270000001 
 Project Title:  USCG Station Cortez 2nd Deck Carpet Removal and Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) Flooring Installation 
 Issuing Agency:  United States Coast Guard (USCG) – Base Miami Beach (P&C) 
 Notice Type:  Combined Synopsis / Solicitation 
 Set-Aside Status:  100% Total Small Business Set-Aside 
 Applicable NAICS Code:  238330 – Flooring Contractors 
 Small Business Size Standard:  $19.0 Million 
 Contract Type:  Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) 
 Acquisition Authority:  FAR Subpart 12.6 (Streamlined Procedures for Evaluation and Solicitation for Commercial Items), FAR Part 13 (Simplified Acquisition Procedures), and FAR Part 15 

 1. General Notice & Acquisition Overview 

 This document constitutes a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services and minor facility improvements prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. 

 
	 
	  Sole Solicitation:  This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; no separate written solicitation will be issued. 
	 
	 
	  Set-Aside:  The solicitation is advertised as a  100% Total Small Business Set-Aside . Offers received from entities other than small business concerns will not be considered. 
	 
	 
	  Basis of Award:  Award will be made using simplified acquisition procedures to the responsible offeror whose quote conforms to all solicitation requirements and represents the  Best Value  to the Government, considering technical approach, past performance, and price. 
	 
	 
	  Performance Requirement:  The contractor shall provide all management, tools, equipment, materials, labor, and supervision required to remove existing carpet and install new Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) flooring and vinyl base molding across approximately 2,887 sq. ft. on the 2nd Deck of the Multipurpose Building at USCG Station Cortez. 
	 
 

 2. Key Procurement Schedule & Contacts 

  Organized Site Visit  

 December 08, 2026 @ 9:00 AM EST 

  Location:  USCG Station Cortez, Bradenton, FL. 
 Coordination POC:  MKC Adam Muniz, Station EPO 
 Email:  Adam.L.Muniz@uscg.mil 
 (Prior coordination required for gate access and escort).  

  Questions Deadline  

 December 15, 2026 @ 1:00 PM EST 

 Submit via email to the Contracting Officer and EPO using the mandatory email subject format below. 

  Proposal Submission Deadline

 Electronic submission via email to the Contracting Officer. 

  Period of Performance  

 Within 45 calendar days post-award 

 Work to commence no later than 15 calendar days post-award and reach final inspection within 45 calendar days. 

  Authorized Work Hours  

 Mon – Fri, 0800 – 1600 (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM EST) 

 Work outside these hours requires prior written authorization from the Station EPO. No weekends or federal holidays authorized.

 4. Proposal Submission Instructions 

 4.1 Submission Methods & Protocols 

 
	 
	  Electronic Submission (Preferred):  Quotes must be submitted electronically via email to Ulric.Waldron@uscg.mil and carbon-copy (CC) Adam.L.Muniz@uscg.mil. Telephone or verbal quotes will not be accepted. 
	 
	 
	  Mail / Hand Delivery:  Hand-delivered or courier submissions must arrive at USCG Base Miami Beach (P&C), Attn: Ulric Waldron, 16001 SW 117th Avenue, Miami, FL 33177 prior to  1:00 PM EST on December 22, 2026 . 
	 
	 
	  Amendments:  Formal amendments and notices of changes will be published via SAM.gov. Offerors must acknowledge all amendments in their quotation. 
	 
 

 4.2 Mandatory Email Subject Formatting 

 Inquiries and proposals without the exact subject line formats may experience severe processing and response delays: 

 
	 
	  Proposal Submission Subject Format:  
	[PROPOSAL SUBMISSION] [30326PR270000001] - [Station Cortez 2nd Deck Carpet Replacement] ([Company Name]) 
	 
	 
	  Question / Clarification Subject Format:  
	[QUESTION SUBMISSION] [30326PR270000001] - [Station Cortez 2nd Deck Carpet Replacement] ([Company Name]) 
	 (Note: Replace [Company Name] with your organization's legal name inside the parentheses).  
	 
 

 4.3 Vendor Administrative Requirements 

 
	 
	  Entity Identification:  Offerors must provide their legal business name, Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN/EIN), CAGE code, and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI). 
	 
	 
	  Active SAM Registration:  Offerors must maintain an  ACTIVE  registration in SAM.gov at the time of proposal submission, prior to award, and throughout performance. 
	 
	 
	  NAICS Registration:  Offerors should have NAICS code  238330  (Flooring Contractors) or related construction/renovation NAICS listed on their SAM profile. 
	 
 

 4.4 Proposal Package Content Requirements 

 To be deemed responsive, offerors must submit: 

 
	 
	  Price Quote:  A completed firm-fixed-price schedule breaking down labor, materials (LVP, adhesive, baseboards), subfloor preparation/grinding, and debris disposal.
